must_keep.quote: Travelers should purchase the lowest available economy class airfare that meets the business needs of the travel, except as outlined below.
must_keep.why: the lowest economy fare that meets the business needs

must_keep.quote: Reasonable fees associated with priority boarding and economy class upgrades (e.g., Economy Plus, exit row, aisle seat, etc.) are reimbursable.
must_keep.why: fees for economy class upgrades such as Economy Plus are reimbursable

must_keep.quote: Business class or first-class seating may be used only if the traveler's applicable officer approves it in writing in advance. One of the following conditions should be met:  Any flight segment has a scheduled in-air flying time more than four hours; or  The total scheduled in-air flight time for all flight segments is more than seven hours; or  A medical justification has been documented and approved by the Equal Opportunity, Affirmative Action, and Disability Services Department (EAD).
must_keep.why: business or first only with the officer's written approval in advance, and a condition

must_keep.quote: Questions regarding the interpretation of this policy should be directed to: Email: financepolicy@vumc.org
must_keep.why: questions on the policy's interpretation go to the finance policy office

must_keep.quote: Exceptions to this policy require approval of the Chief Operating Officer and the Chief Financial Officer.
must_keep.why: exceptions to the policy need the COO's and the CFO's approval

must_keep.quote: Travelers are responsible for ensuring that they have the necessary approval from their supervisor to take a trip prior to committing VUMC funds or incurring expenses.
must_keep.why: the supervisor's approval of the trip before committing funds

design_notes: Line 88 asks for the lowest economy fare, and lines 102-108 regulate only business and first class. Lines 92-93 make fees for 'economy class upgrades (e.g., Economy Plus, exit row, aisle seat, etc.)' reimbursable. Whether a premium economy fare is such an upgrade (book JetBlue premium, $331) or a class of service above economy that the traveller pays for personally (book American economy, $258) is not settled. Hold either; line 654 sends questions of interpretation to the finance policy office.
